title: Crossings with consequences
paragraphs: The history of the missions belongs to a much wider regional story. Korea, Japan, Qing China, and expanding Western powers were connected through diplomacy, commerce, and unequal relationships. The decisions of a small group of travelers were made within conditions none could fully control.

The journey is a compelling entrance into late nineteenth-century history because it joins individual experience to enormous political change. A traveler’s notebook becomes a window on future struggles over sovereignty, education, armed force, commerce, and the meaning of reform.
